Score pairwise ordering accuracy and spend simulation only on pairs the current ranking leaves ambiguous.","reason":"Shifts measured quantity from absolute per-molecule error to pairwise sign agreement; compute then targets ambiguous pairs instead of re-measuring the floor."},{"index":2,"kind":"reframe","meets_criterion":"NA","quote":"Change the order of steps: before adding molecules, make the force field itself the object of compute — a small scaling sweep of the one or two Lennard-Jones or charge parameters plausibly carrying the bias","reason":"Makes force-field parameters the object of compute; more compute buys bias removal and a lower floor, not just re-measurement."},{"index":3,"kind":"reframe","meets_criterion":"NA","quote":"Change the unit of work from molecule to mixture: simulate the blend directly at several compositions, so compute acts on the object actually being ranked","reason":"Changes computed object from pure molecules to blends; compute then buys combinatorial blend screening, not more pure-molecule runs."}]}
